verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a dated API versioning mechanism (Rippling-Api-Version header pinned to YYYY-MM-DD) and SDK version checks, suggesting some version stability practice, but there is no documented deprecation policy, migration timelines, or sunset/EOL commitments for old API versions. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy documentation, versioning changelog, sunset timeline commitments, and independent confirmation of long-term version support.
